title: BarBendingSchedule
description: ArchResidenceBD BBS v0.1.0 (plan section 6, Appendix C W2.4) - the Bar Bending Schedule as data. A mark is one bar shape repeated: its length is the centreline length (the industry convention for bent bars) and its count is how many times it occurs. The weight follows the pi/4 * d^2 law times the steel density, and the same steel is measured from the geometry by the CAD engine (spike S5) - the two numbers must agree. Shapes beyond 'straight'/'link'/'starter' are reserved for the richer detailing later. Generated by archres_core.design.rebar; the shape list and the title block are W3.4's job.

densityKgPerM3.description: The steel density the weights were computed with (mild steel: 7850).

assumptions.description: The authored detailing values the schedule rests on, with their reasons.

mark.description: Stable mark id, e.g. 'C1-MAINS'. The mark is the drawing's handle on the bar.

member.description: The structural member the bar belongs to (a column, a beam, a footing, a slab).

role.description: What the bar does in the member: mains, links, mesh, distribution, starters.

shape.description: The bar shape. v0 builds straight bars, links and starters; the rest are reserved.

lengthMm.description: The centreline length of one bar of this mark (a link is its perimeter).

weightKg.description: count * length * pi/4 d^2 * density, rounded to 4 decimals.

byDiameterKg.description: The weight per diameter, keyed by the diameter in millimetres.
